editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Vantage holds dual Tier-1 regulation — ASIC (AFSL 428901) and FCA (FRN 590299) — and offers raw ECN spreads from 0.0 pips with a $6 round-turn commission that genuinely competes with IC Markets and Pepperstone. But in 2026 most international clients are routed to the VFSC Vanuatu entity with no investor compensation scheme, while FinTelegram reports link the broader Vantage Group to unauthorised adjacent brands. The FCA has warned against a clone entity called Vantage Capital FX — not the real Vantage, but the brand confusion is a genuine risk for traders searching online. UK clients get FSCS protection up to GBP 85,000 and Australian clients get ASIC-mandated fund segregation. Everyone else gets Vanuatu. The trading conditions are legitimately strong. The question is which entity actually holds your money.
